ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels comprise approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white field across both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous irregular band along the entire trailing edge and a vertical rectangular cluster at the peduncle-notch intersection.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and moderate depth relative to the lobe apexes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels, creating a jagged boundary across the entire trailing edge profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on both the left and right lobes, tapering to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters visible at both the left and right distal tips and intermittently along the trailing edge serrations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions are visible on the mid-section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple irregular nicks and notches of varying depths along the trailing edge, particularly a larger indentation on the inner-left lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark vertical strip extending downwards from the central notch base toward the water line.
